executive_summary: Northwind Safety can launch paid search in the UK and Germany, but not yet in the US. Demand is real and priced: 2,140 qualified terms carry a blended CPC of 4.10 GBP, and the profitable half of the historic search-term report already clears a 310 GBP target CPA. Two things block a clean start. Conversion tracking has not recorded a demo request in 41 days and the synthetic probe we fired never surfaced in the Ads API, so spend today would be unmeasurable. And the pricing page fails mobile Core Web Vitals at 4.8s LCP, which is where 61 percent of the qualified terms map. Competitors are spending into a single message — audit readiness — and none of the eleven advertisers we captured mentions multi-site rollout, which is the one claim our own won-deal notes support. Fix tracking, fix the pricing page, and launch against the transactional cluster in the UK first; Germany needs the consent basis on the prospect list resolved before any audience targeting.

launch_blockers.statement: Conversion tracking is stale: the demo_request action has recorded nothing for 41 days and a synthetic click fired on 2026-03-02 never appeared in the Ads API.
The pricing page, the destination for 61% of qualified terms, fails mobile Core Web Vitals at 4.8s LCP.
The German prospect list has no recorded consent basis, so audience targeting in DE cannot be used at launch.

recommended_next_actions.statement: Repair the demo_request conversion action and re-run the synthetic probe before any spend resumes.
Cut the pricing page to a 4-field form and defer the banner script; the 9-field form is the single largest friction point on the highest-intent destination.
Launch GB exact-match on the 412 transactional terms first, at 8,000 USD per month, and hold DE until the consent basis is documented.
Build the multi-site solution page before bidding on the 2 gap clusters; 580 monthly searches currently have nowhere to land.
